# Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level

> What each Claude model (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) costs at every effort level, and which gives the best quality for the price. Open data, CC BY 4.0.

Best value overall: Haiku 5.5 at high effort, 1.9× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 60.1 % on the benchmark panel, cost 2.9× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Haiku 5.5 at low effort; everyday tasks → Haiku 5.5 at medium effort; advanced reasoning → Fable 5.2 at high effort; cutting-edge thinking → Fable 5.2 at max effort. Highest measured quality: Fable 5.2 at max effort (expected score 76.7 %, cost 376× the cheapest couple).

Costs are multiples of the cheapest couple's; quality is the expected score on the benchmark panel. Both are fused from measurements taken on the same task by a latent-quality model that estimates each benchmark's own scale (method: docs/METHODOLOGY.md in the source repository), from 334 sources · 1556 benchmarks · 7353 measurements. Updated 2026-11-12. Figures are indicative, derived from public third-party measurements; not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Report

- [Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level](https://claude-models.agensse.com/): quality vs cost per model and effort level, Pareto frontier, best pick per task tier, normalized cost matrix, method and sources.
- [Fable vs Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku: Claude models head-to-head](https://claude-models.agensse.com/claude-models-head-to-head.html): every pair of Claude models compared effort by effort, and the cheapest effort of each that matches the other.

## Head-to-head

- Fable 5.2 vs Opus 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.2 costs 1.4× to 2.2× what Opus 5.5 costs and scores 2.0 to 5.8 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Opus 5.5 setting reaches Fable 5.2 at max (76.7 %): Opus 5.5's best is max at 74.7 %. To match Opus 5.5 at max (74.7 %, cost 253×), the cheapest Fable 5.2 setting is high (75.0 %, cost 114×): 2.2× cheaper per task.
- Fable 5.2 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.2 costs 2.6× to 5.1× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores 3.4 to 12.5 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5.5 setting reaches Fable 5.2 at max (76.7 %): Sonnet 5.5's best is max at 73.3 %. To match Sonnet 5.5 at max (73.3 %, cost 147×), the cheapest Fable 5.2 setting is medium (73.5 %, cost 60×): 2.4× cheaper per task.
- Fable 5.2 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.2 costs 24× to 42× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 12.1 to 18.6 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Fable 5.2 at max (76.7 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 64.6 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (64.6 %, cost 15×), the cheapest Fable 5.2 setting is low (72.0 %, cost 51×): 3.3× dearer per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 1.7× to 2.7× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores 1.4 to 8.6 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.7 %): Sonnet 5.5's best is max at 73.3 %. To match Sonnet 5.5 at max (73.3 %, cost 147×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is xHigh (73.8 %, cost 94×): 1.6× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 16× to 24× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 10.1 to 13.6 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.7 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 64.6 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (64.6 %, cost 15×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is low (66.2 %, cost 28×): 1.8× dearer per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 7.7× to 11× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 5.0 to 8.7 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (73.3 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 64.6 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (64.6 %, cost 15×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is high (67.2 %, cost 22×): 1.4× dearer per task.
- Fable 5.2 vs Fable 5.1: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.2 costs 0.6× to 1.1× what Fable 5.1 costs and scores 5.6 to 6.9 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Fable 5.2 at max (76.7 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 71.1 %. To match Fable 5.1 at max (71.1 %, cost 340×), the cheapest Fable 5.2 setting is low (72.0 %, cost 51×): 6.7× cheaper per task.
- Fable 5.1 vs Fable 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 0.8× to 1.1× what Fable 5 costs and scores 2.5 to 3.4 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Fable 5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (71.1 %): Fable 5's best is max at 68.3 %. To match Fable 5 at max (68.3 %, cost 337×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is medium (67.7 %, cost 101×): 3.3× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Opus 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 0.4× to 1.3× what Opus 5 costs and scores 2.3 to 5.1 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Opus 5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.7 %): Opus 5's best is max at 69.7 %. To match Opus 5 at max (69.7 %, cost 195×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (70.9 %, cost 42×): 4.7× cheaper per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Sonnet 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 0.4× to 1.1× what Sonnet 5 costs and scores 8.1 to 12.7 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (73.3 %): Sonnet 5's best is max at 60.6 %. To match Sonnet 5 at max (60.6 %, cost 135×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is low (59.5 %, cost 13×): 10× cheaper per task. Sonnet 5's cost is size-sensitive: a verbose model, its cost swings widely between short and long agentic tasks, hence its wide interval.
